name: Tom Bagshaw
description: Tom Bagshaw is a British digital artist based in Bath, England. Renowned for his hauntingly beautiful portraits, he specializes in figurative themes that blend fantasy, mysticism, and feminine strength. His meticulously rendered works are created entirely in the digital realm, yet they evoke the tactile richness of traditional painting techniques. Originally self-taught, Bagshaw transitioned from traditional media to digital art over a decade ago and has since focused on fine art rather than commercial illustration.
